# AI Navi - Fractional AI Leadership

> AI Navi provides fractional AI leadership for UK mid-market Consumer Products and Logistics companies.

## About
AI Navi is a fractional AI consultancy that embeds senior AI leadership into mid-market businesses. We help Consumer Products (FMCG, CPG) and Logistics companies escape "pilot purgatory" and ship production AI systems.

## Services
- AI FlightCheck: AI diagnostic and strategy document for board-level approval
- AI FlightPath Sprint: 90-day implementation sprints to ship production AI
- AI FlightScale Retainer: Ongoing fractional CAIO and CTO support
- AI Data Engineering: Bespoke data infrastructure and pipeline architecture

## Target Audience
- UK mid-market companies (£50M-£500M revenue)
- Consumer Products, FMCG, CPG companies
- Logistics and supply chain businesses
- C-suite executives and operations leaders

## Key Differentiators
- Senior practitioners only (no juniors)
- Production-focused (not just strategy decks)
- Industry-specific expertise in CP and Logistics
- Embedded leadership model
